summary: Show thread failures and refusals in red or yellow, never success green, and keep the footer note from garbling the key hints

replay.detail: Only how the TUI footer draws a passing note changes; no durable data is replayed.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Thread authority and mutation rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Footer notes now carry a severity: Info (neutral), Success (green), Warn (yellow) or Error (red). Thread call sites state theirs; every other note keeps the existing words rule. A note no longer draws over the key hints: hints that do not fit before it are left out whole, and a note wider than the row ends in an ellipsis.

manual.detail: In fractal tui at 80 columns, send a thread action while disconnected (Reconnect to send this thread action) or one Fractal rejects: the note is red, ends in … when long, and no key hint shows in pieces beside it.

recovery.detail: Presentation only; no daemon state, pairings or drafts change.
